title: Possible issue with allocations for custom dispatch use case
body:
I am seeing a correctness issue with calling the same custom dispatch  multiple times, I see a clear problem after `FuseDispatchBindingsPass`  ,  Here is a short gist
https://gist.github.com/nirvedhmeshram/ea15e4d5912af911282dc209da291ee2
The problem is the second dispatch is
```
      stream.cmd.dispatch @mlp_external_f32_f32_f32_i32_i32_i32_executable::@mlp_external_f32_f32_f32_i32_i32_i32_entry_point(%c0, %c0, %14, %10, %11, %11, %0, %6, %5, %6, %0, %6 : index, index, index, i32, i32, i32, index, index, index, index, index, index) {
        ro %arg5[%c0_2 for %15] : !stream.resource<transient>{%15},
        ro %arg3[%c0_2 for %8] : !stream.resource<external>{%8},
        wo %arg5[%c0_2 for %15] : !stream.resource<transient>{%15}
      }
```
Its reading and writing to the same buffer, which would be wrong for a matmul

Here is also the full dump for this
https://gist.github.com/nirvedhmeshram/f8b0c268447c41d9c65c7f8b48d2a618

Draft PR used to create this issue
https://github.com/openxla/iree/pull/16967

commands used to compile and run

```
iree-compile  --iree-preprocessing-pdl-spec-filename=$IREE_HOME/samples/custom_dispatch/cpu/mlp_plugin/mlp_linalg_spec.pdl.mlir $IREE_HOME/samples/custom_dispatch/cpu/mlp_plugin/mlp_linalg_two_matmul.mlir --mlir-print-ir-after-all --mlir-disable-threading -o mlp.vmfb

iree-run-module --device=local-sync --executable_plugin=$IREE_BUILD_DIR/samples/custom_dispatch/cpu/mlp_plugin/mlp_plugin.so --module=mlp.vmfb --function=mlp_invocation --input="8x8xf32=6" --input="8x8xf32=5"
